When in the course of human events, when a government has expanded its power beyond all constitutional limits and refuses to respect the rights and freedoms of its People, it becomes necessary for Free Peoples to separate themselves from such an entity and to declare their causes for so doing. All political power proceeds from the People. The United States of America was founded on the principle that government has no power, except for those powers explicitly enumerated to it by the People. For more than two centuries now, the government of the United States of America has been slowly granting itself ever more power, while simultaneously curtailing the rights and liberties of its People. Even more egregiously, it has undermined and subverted the most powerful tools available to the People to fight back against these encroachments on their rights. The federal government of the United States has repeatedly shown itself unwilling to surrender its illegal and unconstitutional powers voluntarily, so we hereby issue an ultimatum: Surrender all of your unconstitutional powers and return them to the People and to the States, or we will secede. And should you be unwilling to give up your powers, and unwilling to allow us to secede and to once again become a Free People, then by the Power of the Almighty God we will rain down violence upon your heads, and drive you off the face of our nation, that you may never again terrorize and tyrannize the American People. We are loathe to resort to violence in this or in any matter. But when such grievous abuses of have gone on for so long, and are destined to only become more severe, blood would be upon our hands and guilt upon our heads if we failed to finally take action. We call upon all Americans, and upon all Peoples of the world, both bond and free, to join us in condemning the government of the United States of America and demanding it lay down its illegal and unconstitutional powers. And should the government be unwilling to do so, we call upon the American People to rise up against this immoral, tyrannical government that seeks to destroy human freedom.

It is the right, and duty, of free Peoples to rise up against tyranny. To some our grievances may seem a small thing, a lot of sound and fury, signifying nothing. Yet the dissolution of Israel and Judah was brought about by grievous tax burdens. Our own American Revolution was triggered by taxes on tea and other grievances that many of these same People would express similar doubts over. But underlying these revolts, and nearly all revolts in human history, is a lack of respect for the governed by the who govern them and a clear willingness by those governments to ever expand their powers and to trample on the freedoms of their subjects.

So many are the crimes which the United States has committed, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Therefore let it suffice to condemn them for these crimes which are herein written. We hereby condemn the United States of America and assert our right to independence should they be unwilling to yield:

  • • It has made a mockery of the right to free speech, establishing “zones” in which the right may be practiced, far away from the eyes and ears of those who would hear of the crimes of their government.
  • • It has intimidated, bribed, and otherwise interfered with the workings of the free press, preventing them from being the effective watchdogs against government corruption that they are supposed to be.

  • • It has continuously eroded the right to bear arms and the right to self-defense, and has immorally used its influence as well as the money of taxpayers to influence society’s views on these freedoms in order to turn them against them.
  • • It has used secret courts, with no accountability to the public, to conduct illegal surveillance, searches, and seizures in violation of Americans’ 4th amendment rights.
  • • It has subverted the security and safety of our software and other technology in order to perform illegal mass surveillance on its own citizens.
  • • It has unconstitutionally used the taxes of its subjects to give subsidies, beneficial regulation, and other unfair advantages to businesses and persons that purchase its favor.
  • • It has unconstitutionally used tax money from the middle and upper classes to purchase the loyalty and votes of the lower class.
  • • It has unconstitutionally given the President de facto unilateral power to declare war, and has used this power to enter into dozens of illegal and unconstitutional wars and armed conflicts at the cost of the lives of our young men, and the money of its taxpayers.
  • • It has unconstitutionally expanded the voting franchise to the unwitting, unwilling mass and sex, which, in fullness of knowledge, it has propagandized into the establishment of a perpetual oligarchy.
  • • It has debased our currency and has stolen our precious metals by executive order. Furthermore it has given away the control of our money-supply to a semi-private cartel over which congress and the president have only limited oversight and control.
  • • It has supplied, supported, and trained violent terrorists and extremists all over the world, many of whom later went on to turn against us and to commit grievous violence against the American People.

  • • It has used the power of its tax collectors to punish political opponents who dare to work against it, and to cow the masses into submission with the threat of chains.
  • • It has hidden, destroyed, or otherwise obfuscated documents and other critical evidence in order to keep its members and agencies from being held accountable before the law and the Public.
  • • It has destroyed the independence of its citizens by creating labyrinthine rules and regulations that prevent individuals from starting their own enterprises, driving them to work for the government’s corporate cronies instead.
  • • It has given near unlimited power to a panel of merely nine judges, who have a long and storied history of deciding matters of law based on their personal feelings and opinions rather than by the constitutional limits the People have established for the power of the government.
  • • Congress has unfairly used its power and influence to gain personal advantages in the stock market and in other investment markets.
  • • It has given contracts and grants to personal friends, family, and powerful donors.
  • • It has neglected the care of military veterans, and has refused to take anything more than token disciplinary action against those responsible for this neglect.
  • • It has repeatedly undermined the unity and effectiveness of our military forces, and often failed to adequately supply and equip our troops, seemingly in attempts to garner political favor with certain sectors of the public and to give cronies in the defense industry financial advantage over their competitors.
  • • It has perversely taken advantage of tragedies to avoid scrutiny while rushing freedom-destroying laws and regulations through congress.
  • • It has repeatedly and shamelessly bypassed and violated the will of the People via the use of unconstitutional Executive Orders.
  • • It has constantly increased the number of constituents apportioned to each seat of the House, thereby diminishing the power of individual voters and making representatives less accountable, in turn making the bribery and corruption of representatives by powerful influences easier.

  • • It has unconstitutionally mandated participation in economic activity by citizens in order to aid its friends and backers in specific industries.
  • • It has repeatedly overridden and subverted the freedom and sovereignty of the states.
  • • It has used the power of the income tax to economically bribe and blackmail the individual states into bowing to its will.
  • • It has surrendered significant parts of the sovereignty of the nation and its people through treaties and trade agreements.
